about_the_game:
This pack is the second 3D model resource pack based on the "SMILE Characters Vol. 2" DLC for SMILE GAME BUILDER, with blend shapes and motions added by LastSmile for RPG Developer Bakin, and greatly enhanced.

In addition to character models, this version includes a variety of additional elements, such as the "Slipper," a vehicle originally designed by LastSmile that races through the desert, a majestic towering pyramid, bones of giant creatures on a grand scale, a vast desert terrain model, and even particle effects that give a realistic feel.

Take advantage of this voluminous pack, filled with a wealth of content, to add even more depth and intensity to your game.

[SMILE Characters DX Vol.2] Contents

--- 3D Model Details ---

- Characters

Hero Characters: 3 types

Heroine Characters: 3 types

Vehicle: 1

Animated Facial Expressions: 7 different facial expressions with blend shapes

Motions: 71 types (covering movement, combat, standby poses, etc.)

- Map Objects: 20

- Particle Effects: ７

- Sample Maps: 6

---2D Assets Details ---

- Standing Portraits: 6 figures, 4 different facial expressions
